title: Hoboken rent leveling annual increase cap
requirement: A landlord may not request or receive a rent increase at lease expiration or termination of more than 5% or the CPI differential, whichever is less, and no more than one cost-of-living increase per 12-month period.
key_value: 5% or CPI differential, whichever is less
coverage_conditions: Dwellings subject to the Hoboken Rent Leveling and Stabilization chapter; the cap applies at lease expiration or termination and to periodic tenants and lease terms under one year.
exemptions: Newly constructed dwellings and buildings completely vacant since January 1, 1984, where the rent officials determine eligibility for an exemption as defined in the chapter.
quoted_span: At the expiration of a lease or at the termination of a lease of a periodic tenant, no landlord may request or receive a percentage increase in rent which is greater than 5% or the percentage difference between the consumer price index three months prior to the expiration or termination of the lease and three months prior to the commencement of the lease term, whichever is less.
